evidence.title: GitHub - Fonthausen/Livvic: Liverpool Victoria Friendly Society Limited custom typeface

name: Livvic
summary: Specimen page for Livvic, a corporate sans-serif typeface designed by Jacques Le Bailly for UK insurer LV=.
description: The Google Fonts page for the Livvic typeface, a custom corporate sans-serif designed by Jacques Le Bailly for LV=, an insurance company in the UK, as part of a brand redesign. The family is released under the SIL Open Font License and its source repository holds the font files.
